channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Watch: Dog shows love for live classical music
item.description: ABC News' Danny New talks to two professional musicians whose dog, Billy, requests that they play for him.

item.title: Ancient wall discovered beneath Paris hotel may confirm city's origins
item.description: A Gallo-Roman wall was found under a hotel on the Ile de la Cite, near Notre Dame Cathedral.

item.title: Trump-Xi meeting addresses Iran, Taiwan and trade tensions
item.description: President Donald Trump and Chinese leader Xi Jinping will confront several contentious issues during a high-stakes state visit.

item.title: Hurricane Polo becomes powerful Category 4 storm off Mexico
item.description: Hurricane Polo rapidly intensified in the Pacific off southwestern Mexico, reaching Category 5 before weakening to a Category 4.
